name: C-ArmLSpine (Zhang et al., Medical Image Analysis 2024)

pairing.xray: 299 AP and lateral spot frames, and two CBCT projection sweeps of 301 frames
pairing.ct: an intraoperative CBCT of every case, from the same C-arm
pairing.pose: not shipped for the spot frames; the sweeps carry their gantry angles
pairing.masks: none shipped for the vertebral bodies
pairing.annotate: a mask for each vertebral body, L1 to S1, on each CBCT, read by a person and checked by a second reader
pairing.pair_key: the case number: a case's spot frames and its CBCT share one case folder

what: 149 lumbar intraoperative cases from one mobile C-arm: 299 AP and lateral spot frames, an intraoperative CBCT of every case from the same device, and the raw CBCT projection sweeps of two cases (case39 and case134, 301 frames each, rotational); 59,609 DICOM files in the release (Zenodo 22768651)
level_truth: lumbar levels, readable from each case's CBCT; three cases with an L6
how_to_get: Held: on the grid at /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/carmlspine, fetched from Zenodo with the zip's md5 checked on 2026-09-21; nothing to fetch.
To share it with collaborators, copy it into /rs/rs_grp_oschome/shared/datasets/carmlspine/ with its checksums as a Slurm job, as the pig set of #22 was copied, and note the job in the history.
